Sub-millimetre robotic microsurgery requires both adaptive motor skills and rigorous safety guarantees. Unconstrained
deep reinforcement learning and imitation policies achieve high task completion but suffer from uncertified tail
actions that risk catastrophic tissue puncture. Here we introduce SurgiVLA, a safety-constrained
vision-language-action foundation model for sub-millimetre robotic manipulation. SurgiVLA couples a 7B-parameter…
